title: Open Biomedical Knowledge Graphs at Scale: Construction, Federation, and AI Agent Access with Samyama Graph Database
abstract: arXiv:2603.15080v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Biomedical knowledge is fragmented across siloed databases---Reactome, STRING, Gene Ontology, ClinicalTrials.gov, DrugBank, DGIdb, SIDER, PubMed, ClinVar, ChEMBL, OpenTargets, and more. We present an open, reproducible biomedical knowledge graph ecosystem built on Samyama, a Rust-native graph database: three foundational graphs detailed end-to-end---Pathways KG (118,686 nodes, 834,785 edges), Clinical Trials KG (7,774,446 nodes, 26,973,997 edges), and Drug Interactions KG (32,726 nodes, 191,970 edges)---and their expansion into a 22-graph, 2-cohort merged biomedical store (328,130,739 nodes and 1,441,425,733 imported edges, including 295,000 synthetic OMOP CDM patients from Synthea). First, we describe a reproducible ETL and portable .sgsnap snapshot pattern where graphs load alone or compose into one store. Second, we analyze single-store cross-KG integration via query-time property joins and load-time identifier deduplication

translated_title: 大规模开放生物医学知识图谱：基于Samyama图数据库的构建、联邦与AI智能体访问
translated_abstract: 生物医学知识分散于各个孤立的数据库中——包括Reactome、STRING、基因本体（Gene Ontology）、ClinicalTrials.gov、DrugBank、DGIdb、SIDER、PubMed、ClinVar、ChEMBL、OpenTargets等。我们提出了一个建立在Samyama（一种Rust原生图数据库）之上的开放、可复现的生物医学知识图谱生态系统：端到端地详细介绍了三个基础图谱——通路知识图谱（Pathways KG，118,686个节点，834,785条边）、临床试验知识图谱（Clinical Trials KG，7,774,446个节点，26,973,997条边）和药物相互作用知识图谱（Drug Interactions KG，32,726个节点，191,970条边）——以及它们扩展为包含22个图谱、2个队列的合并生物医学存储（328,130,739个节点和1,441,425,733条导入边，其中包括来自Synthea的295,000名合成OMOP CDM患者）。首先，我们描述了一种可复现的ETL流程和可移植的.sgsnap快照模式，使图谱既可以单独加载，也可以组合为一个统一存储。其次，我们分析了通过查询时属性连接和加载时标识符去重实现的单存储跨知识图谱集成。
tldr: 该论文基于Rust原生图数据库Samyama构建了开放、可复现的生物医学知识图谱生态系统，整合22个图谱、超过3.28亿节点和14.4亿条边，通过可移植快照与跨图谱集成技术打通碎片化的生物医学数据并支持AI智能体访问。
en_tdlr: The paper presents an open, reproducible biomedical knowledge graph ecosystem built on the Rust-native Samyama graph database, integrating 22 graphs with over 328 million nodes and 1.44 billion edges through portable snapshots and cross-KG integration to unify fragmented biomedical data and enable AI agent access.
